extensionAttribute.description: Returns the installed OpenSSH client version (the LibreSSL-linked build that ships with macOS).
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # SSH Version Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
version=$(/usr/bin/ssh -V 2>&1)
echo "<result>${version:-Unknown}</result>"
